sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Melancholy; bashful, ill at ease in society,
irritable, delights in solitude and obscurity. Sense of
right and wrong abolished.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
FahitinR fit front climbing mountains,
fhkks coming from occiput with vertigo. Noises in


251

car. Headache with vertigo, preceded by flashes of
light. Like a band across forehead. Diplopia. Tongue
furred. Headaches of high altitudes. Tinnitus.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Peppery sensation in mouth. Longing
for alcoholic liquors and tobacco. Great satiety for a
long time. Incarcerated flatus; rises with noise and
violence, as if it would split the oesophagus. Tympanitic
distention of abdomen. No appetite but for sweets.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text: Palpitation, with weak heart and dyspnoea.

sections.label: Male
sections.text: Diabetes, with impotency. [Phos. ac.]

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Hawking of small, transparent pieces
of mucus. Weak vocal cords. Hoarseness; worse after
talking. Want of breath, short breath, especially in
aged athletes, and alcoholic users. Haemoptysis. Asthma,
spasmodic variety.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Can find no rest anywhere, but sleepy.
Nervousness and nightly restlessness during teething.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Better, from wine ; riding, quick motion
in open air. Worse, ascending, high altitudes.

[Nat. mur.] Tongue feels thick and numb. Burning
